realm.name: investigating_officer
realm.description: Field officer; access limited to cases within their own department

realm.name: auditor
realm.description: Read-only access across all departments; MFA required

_comment_ABAC: ABAC-style policies (IOs restricted to their own department's cases;
auditors read-only everywhere) are configured under the client's
Authorization Services tab (Resources / Policies / Permissions) once
the client and department attribute mapper exist — that part isn't
expressible in this static realm-export skeleton and must be done
through the Admin Console, then re-exported to update this file.
_comment_MFA: This skeleton enables the CONFIGURE_TOTP required action realm-wide.
To restrict it to roles above investigating_officer specifically,
bind CONFIGURE_TOTP as a required action per-user or via a
conditional flow in Authentication > Flows, then re-export.
